title: Maximum Product Subarray
statement:
Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray which has the largest product and return that product.

A subarray is a contiguous part of an array.
constraints: The product of any prefix or suffix of nums is guaranteed to fit in a 32-bit integer.

visibleExamples.explanation: The subarray [2, 3] has the largest product 6.
The array contains only one element.
The subarray [-2, 3, -4] has the largest product 24.
